source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 19 exercise solved (PDF 150-154): MCQs with keys and reasons, model answers for short, long and inquisitive questions, Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 19 (Chromosome and DNA) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb aur kitab ke numbers ke saath (MCQs 16-34, short 17-24, long 15-31, inquisitive 7-12, kyun ke kitab chapter 18 se numbering jari rakhti hai). Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
16. Which of the following looks like beads on a string?
(In mein se kaun si cheez dhaage par moti (beads on a string) jaisi dikhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har histone octamer ke gird DNA ke taqreeban 146 nucleotides do chakkar lapat kar nucleosome banate hain, jo linker DNA se jure hote hain; nucleosomes ki yeh lari dhaage par motiyon jaisi lagti hai, ise nucleosome string (11 nm) kehte hain (19.1.2).

blocks.prompt:
17. The most convincing proof that DNA is the genetic material was provided by;
(Is baat ka sab se pukhta saboot ke DNA hi genetic material hai, kis ne diya?)
blocks.explanation: Hershey aur Chase (1952) ne dikhaya ke bacteriophage ka 32P wala DNA bacteria ke andar gaya aur naye phages banwaye, jab ke 35S wala protein coat bahar raha (19.2.2). Meselson aur Stahl ne semi-conservative replication saabit ki thi, DNA ka genetic material hona nahi.

blocks.prompt:
18. Degeneracy of genetic code means that;
(Genetic code ki degeneracy (ek amino acid ke kai codons) ka matlab hai ke;)

options.text: Kai codons ek hi amino acid bata sakte hain
Ek codon kai amino acids bata sakta hai
Har codon saath wale codons se alag parha jata hai

blocks.explanation: Degeneracy ka matlab hai ke ek hi amino acid ke liye kai codons hote hain (19.4.2). Option (a) triplet hone ki aur (d) non-overlapping (ek doosre par na charhne wala) hone ki khasiyat hai.

blocks.prompt:
19. How many codons are needed to specify for five amino acids?
(Paanch amino acids batane ke liye kitne codons chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Har codon (teen nucleotides) ek amino acid batata hai, is liye paanch amino acids ke liye paanch codons (yani 15 nucleotides) chahiye (19.4.1). 15 nucleotides ki tadaad hai, codons ki nahi.

blocks.prompt:
20. Which of the following is NOT involved in the initiation of replication?
(In mein se kaun replication ke aaghaz (initiation) mein shamil NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Helix kholte waqt aur primer banate waqt helicase, gyrase, single-strand binding proteins aur primase kaam karte hain; DNA ligase aakhir mein Okazaki fragments ko jorta hai (19.3.3).

blocks.prompt:
21. Why DNA polymerase synthesises the leading and lagging strands of DNA in different manners?
(DNA polymerase leading aur lagging strands ko mukhtalif tareeqon se kyun banata hai?)

options.text: Replication origins sirf 5′ sire par hote hain
DNA ligase sirf 3′ se 5′ rukh mein kaam karta hai
DNA polymerase ek waqt mein sirf ek strand par kaam karta hai
DNA polymerase naye nucleotides sirf strand ke 3′ sire par jor sakta hai

blocks.explanation: DNA polymerase III naya nucleotide sirf 3′ sire par jorta hai, is liye strand sirf 5′ se 3′ rukh mein banta hai. Dono template strands ulte rukh (antiparallel) mein hain, is liye ek strand musalsal (leading) aur doosra tukron, yani Okazaki fragments, mein (lagging) banta hai (19.3.3).

blocks.prompt:
22. Synthesis of a new DNA strand usually begins with:
(Naye DNA strand ki tayyari aam tor par kis se shuru hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primase pehle 5-10 RNA nucleotides ka chhota RNA primer lagata hai; DNA polymerase III pehla DNA nucleotide isi ke 3′ sire par jorta hai (19.3.3).

blocks.prompt:
23. The elongation of the leading strand during DNA synthesis;
(DNA banne ke dauran leading strand ki lambai barhna (elongation);)

options.text: Replication fork se door ki taraf chalta hai
Polymerase ke amal par munhasir hai

blocks.explanation: Leading strand ko DNA polymerase III musalsal lamba karta hai, fork ki taraf aur 5′ se 3′ rukh mein; fork se door barhna aur Okazaki fragments lagging strand ki khasiyat hain (19.3.3).

blocks.prompt:
24. Which of the following enzymes remove supercoiling in replicating DNA ahead of the replication fork?
(Kaun se enzymes replication fork ke aage DNA ki supercoiling (zyada bal) khatam karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Helix khulne se fork ke aage supercoils bante hain; gyrase (jo topoisomerase hai) fork ke aage jur kar inhein khatam karta hai (19.3.3). Helicase sirf helix kholta hai.

blocks.prompt:
25. Which enzyme joins the bits of DNA?
(Kaun sa enzyme DNA ke tukron ko jorta hai?)
blocks.explanation: DNA ligase lagging strand ke Okazaki fragments ko phosphodiester bonds bana kar jorta hai (19.3.3); genetic engineering mein bhi yehi 'molecular glue' (gond) hai.

blocks.prompt:
26. Which of these subunits of RNA polymerase is required to initiate transcription?
(RNA polymerase ki kaun si subunit transcription shuru karne ke liye zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: σ (sigma) subunit promoter ko pehchanti hai aur RNA banana shuru karwati hai; jurne ke baad yeh alag ho jati hai aur core enzyme kaam jari rakhta hai (19.5).

blocks.prompt:
27. When and where does the splicing of mRNA occur?
(mRNA ki splicing kab aur kahan hoti hai?)

options.text: mRNA ke ribosome se jurne ke baad

blocks.explanation: Splicing transcription ke baad hone wali tabdeeli (post-transcriptional modification) hai jo naye eukaryotic mRNA ke nucleus se cytoplasm mein jane se pehle hoti hai (19.5).

blocks.prompt:
28. What happens in mRNA splicing?
(mRNA splicing mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: Gene se introns aur exons dono nikal diye jate hain
Introns aur exons aapas mein jor diye jate hain
Exons nikal kar introns jor diye jate hain
Introns nikal kar exons jor diye jate hain

blocks.explanation: Kachay mRNA se introns (jo protein ka code nahi rakhte) nikal diye jate hain aur bache hue exons jor diye jate hain; pakka (mature) mRNA sirf code wale hisson par mushtamil hota hai (19.5).

blocks.prompt:
29. Which of these happens first during protein synthesis?
(Protein banne ke dauran in mein se sab se pehle kya hota hai?)

options.text: Aminoacyl tRNA ka ribosome se jurna
Release factor ka ribosome se jurna

blocks.explanation: Initiation mein sab se pehle pehla aminoacyl-tRNA ribosome ki chhoti subunit se jurta hai. Peptide bond aur translocation elongation mein, aur release factor termination (khatme) par aate hain (19.6).

blocks.prompt:
30. The synthesis of protein chains is initiated with the amino acid;
(Protein chain ka aaghaz kis amino acid se hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Start codon AUG methionine batata hai; prokaryotes mein yeh tabdeel shuda N-formyl methionine hota hai (19.4.1, 19.6).

blocks.prompt:
31. The main function of tRNA is to:
(tRNA ka asal kaam kya hai?)

options.text: mRNA ko ribosome ki chhoti subunit se jorna
Complementary RNA aur DNA strands ko jorna
Cytoplasm se amino acids ribosomes tak lana

blocks.explanation: Har tRNA ek khaas amino acid (aminoacyl-tRNA ki shakal mein) ribosome tak lata hai aur apne anticodon ko mRNA ke codon se mila kar use sahi jagah rakhta hai (19.6).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (d) chhote harf se shuru aur aakhir mein faltu sawaliya nishan (?) ke saath chhapa hai. Durust: "Bring amino acids from the cytoplasm to the ribosomes".

blocks.prompt:
32. Ultraviolet radiation can cause mutations by;
(Ultraviolet (UV) shuaein mutation kaise paida karti hain?)

options.text: Saath saath wale pyrimidine bases ke darmiyan double covalent bond bana kar
DNA strands ke phosphodiester bonds tor kar

blocks.explanation: Jab do saath wale pyrimidine nucleotides (C aur T) UV jazb karte hain to un ke darmiyan double covalent bond ban jata hai jo replication rok sakta hai. Phosphodiester bonds torna ionizing radiation (X rays, gamma rays) ka asar hai (19.8.1).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (c) mein "in NA" chhapa hai; yeh "in DNA" hona chahiye tha (Adding nucleotides in DNA).

blocks.prompt:
33. Phenylketonuria is a genetic disorder with a defect in the metabolism of:
(Phenylketonuria kis cheez ke metabolism (tabdeeli ke amal) ki kharabi wali genetic bimari hai?)
blocks.explanation: PKU mein jigar (liver) ka enzyme phenylalanine hydroxylase theek nahi banta, is liye amino acid phenylalanine tyrosine mein tabdeel nahi hota aur jama ho jata hai (19.8.1).

blocks.prompt:
34. The condition sickle cell anaemia is due to;
(Sickle cell anaemia ki wajah kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: β-globin gene mein DNA nucleotide T ki jagah A aa jata hai, is liye CTC (glutamic acid) CAC (valine) ban jata hai: yeh substitution qism ki point mutation hai (19.8.1).

blocks.prompt:
17. What are the four types of chromosomes on the basis of position of centromere?
Centromere ki jagah ki bunyad par chromosomes ki chaar qismein kaun si hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Metacentric: centromere bilkul beech mein (dono baazu barabar).
2. Sub-metacentric: centromere beech se thora hat kar.
3. Acrocentric: centromere ek sire ke qareeb.
4. Telocentric: centromere bilkul sire par.

blocks.prompt:
18. What is chromatin fibre? How is it formed during condensation of chromatin?
Chromatin fibre kya hai? Chromatin ke condense (simatne) ke dauran yeh kaise banta hai?
blocks.explanation:
Chromatin fibre ghanay ghanay jure nucleosomes ka 30 nm mota dhaaga hai.
Banna: DNA histone octamers ke gird lipat kar nucleosome string (11 nm) banata hai; cell division ke shuru mein yeh string apne mehwar (axis) ke gird dobara lipatti hai aur sime hue nucleosomes 30 nm mota chromatin fibre banate hain, jo aage tah ho kar 300 nm supercoil banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
19. Briefly describe the concept of gene and gene locus.
Gene aur gene locus ka tasawwur mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Gene: virasat (heredity) ki bunyadi ikaai (lafz Johannsen ne 1909 mein diya); DNA ka chhota hissa jo kisi khaas polypeptide ke amino acids ki tarteeb ka code rakhta hai.
Gene locus: chromosome par gene ki khaas jagah (jama loci); kisi gene ke alleles homologous chromosomes par isi jagah hote hain.

blocks.prompt:
20. State the functions of DNA polymerase I, II and III.
DNA polymerase I, II aur III ke kaam bataein.
blocks.explanation:
DNA polymerase I: RNA primers hata kar khali jagah (Okazaki fragments ke darmiyan bhi) DNA nucleotides se bharta hai.
DNA polymerase II: cell ki zindagi bhar DNA ke nuqsan ki marammat (repair) karta hai.
DNA polymerase III: asal replication enzyme; 3′ sire par 5′ se 3′ rukh mein nucleotides jor kar leading aur lagging strands banata hai aur ghaltiyan jaanchta (proofreading) hai.

blocks.prompt:
21. State the central dogma of gene expression.
Gene expression ka central dogma bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Central dogma (Francis Crick): genetic maloomat DNA se gene ki RNA copy mein jati hai aur RNA amino acids jor kar protein banwata hai: DNA → RNA → Protein. Is ke do qadam hain, transcription aur translation; maloomat ka bahao ek tarfa hai, protein se wapas nahi jati.

blocks.prompt:
22. What do you mean by “degeneracy of genetic code”?
"Genetic code ki degeneracy" se kya murad hai?
blocks.explanation: Degeneracy ka matlab hai ke ek hi amino acid ke liye ek se zyada codons hote hain (64 codons sirf 20 amino acids ke liye), maslan GGC aur GGU dono glycine ke liye. Is wajah se kuch mutations be-asar (silent) rehti hain aur evolution mein lachak milti hai.

blocks.prompt:
23. Enlist some commonly occurring minor mutations in human.
Insanon mein aam paayi jane wali chhoti (minor) mutations ki fehrist banayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. SNPs (single nucleotide polymorphisms): ek nucleotide ki tabdeeli, maslan lactose (doodh ki cheeni) hazam na kar sakna.
2. Insertions aur deletions: maslan cystic fibrosis mein teen nucleotides ka nikal jana.
3. Silent mutations: amino acid nahi badalta (GGC se GGU, dono glycine).
4. Missense mutations: ek amino acid badal jata hai, maslan sickle cell anaemia.
5. Nonsense mutations: waqt se pehle stop codon, maslan Duchenne muscular dystrophy.

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Histone and nucleosome
Histone aur nucleosome mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Histones proteins hain; nucleosome woh ikaai hai jo in ke gird DNA lipatne se banti hai.

rows: Basic (musbat charge wala) protein, arginine aur lysine se bharpoor
DNA aur histones ki mili hui ikaai
Paanch qismein: H1, H2A, H2B, H3, H4
Histone octamer ke gird DNA ke taqreeban 146 nucleotides ke do chakkar
Linker DNA se jure nucleosomes nucleosome string (dhaage par moti) banate hain

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Heterochromatin and euchromatin
Heterochromatin aur euchromatin mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Heterochromatin ghair faal (inactive) gehra rang lene wala hissa hai; euchromatin faal (active) hissa hai.

rows: Genes aam tor par express nahi hote

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Conservative and semi-conservative model of DNA replication
DNA replication ke conservative aur semi-conservative model mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Meselson aur Stahl ne saabit kiya ke replication semi-conservative hai.

rows: Parent double helix saalim rehta hai
Parent ke dono strands alag ho jate hain
Ek daughter DNA mein dono purane, doosre mein dono naye strands
Har daughter DNA mein ek purana aur ek naya strand

blocks.prompt:

• DNA helicase and DNA gyrase
DNA helicase aur DNA gyrase mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Helicase helix kholta hai; gyrase is se paida hone wala bal (supercoil) khatam karta hai.

rows: Origin aur fork par helix kholne wala enzyme
Topoisomerase jo fork ke aage jurta hai
Base pairs ke hydrogen bonds torta hai
Helix khulne se bane supercoils khatam karta hai
Dono strands alag kar ke replication forks banata hai
Dobara supercoiling hone se rokta hai

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• DNA polymerase I and II
DNA polymerase I aur II mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Polymerase I replication ke aakhir mein, aur polymerase II marammat mein kaam karta hai.

rows: Replication mein polymerase III ki madad karta hai
RNA primers hata kar khali jagah DNA se bharta hai
Cell ki zindagi bhar DNA ke nuqsan ki marammat

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Leading strand and lagging strand of DNA
DNA ke leading aur lagging strand mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono 5′ se 3′ bante hain, magar fork ke lehaz se ulte rukh mein.

rows: Ruk ruk kar tukron mein banta hai
Replication fork ki taraf barhta hai
Replication fork se door barhta hai
Har Okazaki fragment ke liye naya primer
Okazaki fragments jinhein DNA ligase jorta hai

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Translation and transcription
Translation aur transcription mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Transcription gene expression ka pehla aur translation doosra qadam hai.

rows: mRNA ki maloomat se protein banta hai
DNA template se RNA banta hai
tRNA, ribosomes aur amino acids istemal

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Genetic code and codon
Genetic code aur codon mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Genetic code poora paigham hai; codon us ka ek 'lafz' hai.

rows: Protein banane ke liye DNA mein maujood maloomat
Polypeptide ke tamam amino acids ki tarteeb batata hai
Ek amino acid (ya stop) batata hai

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Codon and anticodon
Codon aur anticodon mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: tRNA ka anticodon mRNA ke codon se jora banata hai.

rows: Codon ka complementary (jora); munasib amino acid lata hai
Stop codons ka koi anticodon nahi

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Gene and allele
Gene aur allele mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Alleles ek hi gene ki mukhtalif shaklein hain.

rows: DNA ka hissa jo polypeptide ka code rakhta hai (virasat ki ikaai)
Kisi sift (character) ko control karta hai, maslan aankh ka rang
Usi sift ki ek qism deta hai
Alleles homologous chromosomes par isi locus par

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Intron and exon
Intron aur exon mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Splicing mein introns nikal diye jate hain aur exons jor diye jate hain.

rows: DNA ya mRNA ka ghair coding hissa
Coding hissa jo protein banata hai
Splicing mein kachay mRNA se nikal diya jata hai
Jor kar mature mRNA banta hai

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Start codon and stop codon
Start codon aur stop codon mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Start codon translation shuru aur stop codon khatam karta hai.

rows: Protein banana khatam karta hai (release factor pehchanta hai)

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Non-sense codon and sense codon
Non-sense codon aur sense codon mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: 64 codons mein se 61 sense aur 3 nonsense codons hain.

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Repressor and activator proteins
Repressor aur activator proteins mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono regulatory proteins promoter ke qareeb jurte hain magar asar ulta hai.

rows: Operator se jur kar RNA polymerase ka rasta rokte hain
RNA polymerase ko promoter se jurne mein madad
Transcription rok dete ya kam karte hain
Transcription shuru ya tez karte hain

blocks.prompt:

• Point mutation and chromosomal mutation
Point mutation aur chromosomal mutation mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Farq size ka hai: point mutation chhoti, chromosomal mutation bari.

Chromosomes ki banawat ya tadaad ki tabdeeli

blocks.prompt:
24. Differentiate between:
• Down syndrome and Klinefelter syndrome
Down syndrome aur Klinefelter syndrome mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono mein 47 chromosomes hain, magar izafi chromosome mukhtalif hai.

rows: Zehni kamzori, chapta chehra, tirchhi aankhein, dil ke naqais
Baanjh mard, chhote testes, chhati ka barhna, lambi tangein

24. Differentiate between:
• Klinefelter syndrome and Tuners syndrome
Klinefelter syndrome aur Turner syndrome mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono sex chromosomes ki non-disjunction (alag na hone) se hote hain.

rows: Chhote testes, chhati ka barhna, lambi tangein
Chhota qad, jaali dar (webbed) gardan, kachay jinsi aaza
Growth hormone aur estrogen se ilaj

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Aakhri jora "Tuners syndrome" chhapa hai; durust naam "Turner syndrome" hai.

blocks.prompt:
15. Annotate the detailed structure of a chromosome.
Chromosome ki tafseeli banawat (labels ke saath) bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Banawat (replicate shuda, sime hue chromosome ki label wali shakal lafzon mein):
1. Do sister chromatids: interphase mein replication ke baad bane do hu-ba-hu strands.
2. Centromere: chromatids ko jorne wali tang jagah; taqreeban 220 nucleotides ki khaas DNA tarteeb.
3. Kinetochore: centromere par disc jaisi protein banawat jahan spindle fibres jurte hain.
4. Secondary constriction (NOR, nucleolar organizer region): interphase mein nucleolus banati hai.
5. Satellite: secondary constriction ke paar knob (ghundi) jaisa sira, jis mein bar bar dohraya gaya (junk) DNA hai.
6. Telomeres: aakhri sire jo chromosomes ko siron se aapas mein chipakne nahi dete.
Centromere ki jagah se qismein: metacentric, sub-metacentric, acrocentric, telocentric.
Keemiyai banawat aur tanzeem:
1. Taqreeban 40% DNA aur 60% proteins (histones). DNA par manfi charge (phosphate), histones par musbat charge (arginine, lysine), is liye mazboot jor.
2. Nucleosome string (11 nm): taqreeban 146 nucleotides octamer (H2A, H2B, H3, H4 do do) ke gird do chakkar; nucleosomes taqreeban 80 nucleotides ke linker DNA se jure; H1 histone DNA ke dakhil aur kharij hone ki jagah.
3. Chromatin fibre (30 nm): nucleosome string dobara lipatti hai.
4. Supercoil (300 nm): fibre khud par tah hota hai.
5. Chromatid (700 nm): supercoil mazeed lipat kar simat jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: moti (nucleosome, 11 nm) → rassi (chromatin fibre, 30 nm) → kundli (supercoil, 300 nm) → chromatid (700 nm). Har qadam par DNA mazeed lipat kar mota aur chhota hota jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
16. Explain the concept of alleles as the alternative forms of a gene.
Alleles ko gene ki mutabadil (doosri) shaklon ke tor par samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Gene DNA ka chhota hissa hai jo kisi polypeptide ka code rakh kar ek sift (character) control karta hai; chromosome par us ki jagah locus hai.
2. Diploid jandaron ke body cells mein chromosomes homologous joron mein hote hain, ek maa se aur ek baap se.
3. Gene ki mutabadil shaklein alleles hain. Yeh dono homologous chromosomes par usi locus par hoti hain. Agar ek chromosome par kisi locus par aankh ke rang ka allele hai to us ke homologue par bhi usi locus par aankh ke rang ka allele hoga.
4. Alleles ki nucleotide tarteeb mein thora farq hota hai, is liye un ki products thori mukhtalif hoti hain aur ek hi sift ki mukhtalif shaklein (maslan aankh ke mukhtalif rang) aati hain.
5. Naye alleles mutation se bante hain; har shakhs mein har gene ke do alleles hote hain jo ek jaise ya mukhtalif ho sakte hain.

blocks.prompt:
17. Narrate the experimental work of Griffith that proved that DNA is the hereditary material.
Griffith ka tajurba bayan karein jis ne dikhaya ke DNA virasati maadda hai.
blocks.explanation:
Griffith (1928) ne Streptococcus pneumoniae par kaam kiya jis ki do qismein (strains) hain:
- S-type: polysaccharide coat (ghilaf), hamwar (smooth) colonies, bimari paida karne wali (virulent).
- R-type: coat nahi, khurdari (rough) colonies, be-zarar.
Choohon par tajurbe:
1. Zinda S-type: choohe pneumonia se mar gaye.
2. Zinda R-type: choohe zinda rahe.
3. Garmi se mare hue S-type: choohe zinda rahe.
4. Mare hue S-type + zinda R-type: choohe mar gaye aur un ke khoon mein zinda S-type bacteria mile.
Nateeja: mare hue S-type se koi maadda zinda R-type mein gaya aur use coat banane aur virulent banne ki maloomat de di. Is ko transformation kaha (ek jandar se doosre mein genetic maadde ki muntaqili jo lene wale ki genetic banawat badal de). Griffith yeh na bata saka ke yeh maadda DNA tha, protein ya dono.
Baad mein Avery, MacLeod aur McCarty (1944) ne mare hue S-type se proteins nikale to transformation phir bhi hui; DNA nikala to ruk gayi. Is tarah DNA hi transforming principle, yani virasati maadda, saabit hua.

blocks.prompt:
18. Narrate the experimental work of Hershey and Chase that proved that DNA is the hereditary material.
Hershey aur Chase ka tajurba bayan karein jis ne saabit kiya ke DNA virasati maadda hai.
blocks.explanation:
Hershey aur Chase (1952) ne bacteriophage (DNA core aur protein coat) istemal kiya jo bacterium mein koi maadda dakhil karta hai aur phir naye phages bante hain.
Sawal: phage DNA dakhil karta hai, protein ya dono?
Nishan lagana (labelling):
1. Phages 35S par paale gaye: sulphur amino acids mein gaya, yani protein coat par nishan (DNA mein sulphur nahi).
2. Phages 32P par paale gaye: phosphorus phosphate groups mein gaya, yani DNA par nishan.
Setups: setup 1 mein 35S-protein wale phages, setup 2 mein 32P-DNA wale phages ne bacteria ko infect kiya. Kuch der baad centrifugation se bacterial cells aur medium alag kar ke radioactivity jaanchi.
Natije:
- Setup 1: radioactivity medium mein, bacteria mein nahi.
- Setup 2: radioactivity bacteria mein, medium mein nahi.
Nateeja: phage ka DNA bacteria mein gaya aur naye phages banwaye, protein coat bahar raha. Is liye DNA hi virasati maadda hai, protein nahi.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Tracer (nishan lagane wala isotope) ka kamaal: protein mein sulphur hota hai magar DNA mein nahi; DNA mein phosphorus hota hai. Is liye 35S sirf protein ko aur 32P sirf DNA ko 'rang' deta hai, aur pata chal jata hai ke kaun sa hissa bacterium ke andar gaya.

blocks.prompt:
19. Describe the three models proposed about the mechanism of DNA replication.
DNA replication ke tareeqe ke bare mein pesh kiye gaye teen models bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Conservative model: parent double helix saalim rehta hai aur bilkul naya double helix banata hai. Replication ke baad ek daughter DNA mein dono purane strands, doosre mein dono naye strands.
2. Semi-conservative model: parent ke dono strands alag hote hain aur har ek naye strand ke liye template (sancha) banta hai. Har daughter DNA mein ek purana aur ek naya strand.
3. Dispersive model: parent DNA tukron (nucleotides) mein bikhar jata hai jo naye nucleotides se milte hain; daughter DNAs ke chaaron strands purane aur naye hisson ka mel hote hain.
Meselson aur Stahl (1958) ne saabit kiya ke DNA semi-conservative tareeqe se replicate hota hai.

header: Ek replication ke baad daughter DNAs
rows: Ek bilkul purana, ek bilkul naya double helix
Dono hybrid: ek purana + ek naya strand
Dono ke strands purane aur naye ka mel

blocks.prompt:
20. Narrate the work of Meselson and Stahl to justify the semi-conservative replication.
Semi-conservative replication saabit karne ke liye Meselson aur Stahl ka kaam bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Tajurba (1958):
1. E. coli bacteria ko kai nasalon tak bhari (heavy) nitrogen 15N wale medium mein paala gaya, is liye un ka DNA ghana (dense, 15N-DNA) ho gaya.
2. Phir unhein aam 14N wale medium mein muntaqil kiya aur waqfe waqfe se DNA ke namoone liye.
3. DNA caesium chloride ke mehlool (solution) mein ultracentrifuge kiya; density ka gradient bana aur har DNA wahan ruka jahan us ki density caesium ke barabar thi (bhari DNA neeche, halka upar).
Mushahidat aur wazahat:
- 0 minute (koi replication nahi): ek bhari band; dono strands 15N.
- 20 minute (pehli replication): ek darmiyani (intermediate) band; har DNA hybrid, ek 15N aur ek 14N strand.
- 40 minute (doosri replication): do bands, ek darmiyani aur ek halka; har hybrid ne ek bhari strand naye hybrid ko aur ek halka strand bilkul 14N DNA ko diya.
Nateeja: har daughter DNA ek purana strand rakhta aur ek naya banata hai, yani replication semi-conservative hai. (Conservative model pehli replication ke baad bhari aur halka band deta; dispersive model kabhi alag halka band na deta.)

blocks.prompt:
21. Describe the events of the process of DNA replication.
DNA replication ke amal ke waqiat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Replication S-phase mein hoti hai; qadam (prokaryotes ki misaal):
1. Double helix kholna: initiator protein replication origin se jurta hai (prokaryotes mein ek, eukaryotes mein kai). Helicase base pairs ke hydrogen bonds tor kar do Y-shakal replication forks (replication bubble) banata hai. Fork ke aage gyrase (topoisomerase) supercoils khatam karta hai. Single-strand binding proteins strands ko dobara jurne nahi dete. Forks ek doosre se door chalte hain.
2. Primer banana: primase origin par har template par 5-10 RNA nucleotides ka chhota RNA primer lagata hai.
3. Extension (lamba karna): DNA polymerase III deoxyribonucleoside triphosphates (dATP, dCTP, dGTP, dTTP) ko base pairing (A-T, C-G) se jorta hai; do phosphates alag hone se energy milti hai. Yeh sirf 3′ sire par jorta hai, is liye 5′ se 3′ banata hai.
- Leading strand: ek primer se fork ki taraf musalsal.
- Lagging strand: fork se door, tukron (Okazaki fragments) mein, har tukre ka apna primer.
4. Termination: termination site par (origin se termination site tak = replicon) DNA polymerase I RNA primers hata kar DNA se bharta hai aur DNA ligase Okazaki fragments jorta hai.
Polymerase III ghaltiyan bhi theek karta hai (stability); kabhi kabhar reh jane wali ghalti mutation hai (variability).

blocks.prompt:
22. Explain the mechanism of transcription.
Transcription ka tareeqa-e-kaar samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Transcription DNA ke template (antisense) strand ke complementary RNA ka banna hai; doosra strand coding (sense) strand hai. Primer ki zaroorat nahi.
1. Initiation: RNA polymerase promoter se jurta hai (promoter khud transcribe nahi hota): prokaryotes mein TTGACA (-35 sequence) aur TATAAT (-10 sequence); eukaryotes mein TATA box TATAAA (-25) aur CAAT box GGCCAATCT (-70). RNA polymerase ki paanch subunits: do α (regulatory proteins se jurti), β′ (template DNA se), β (RNA nucleotides se) aur σ (promoter pehchan kar shuru karwati). Jurne ke baad σ alag; core enzyme DNA khol kar transcription bubble banata hai.
2. Elongation: RNA polymerase template ke mutabiq rNTPs ko 5′ se 3′ rukh mein jorta hai, aam tor par A ya G se shuru; do phosphates nikalne se energy. Pehle 12 bases DNA ke saath aarzi RNA-DNA helix banate hain jo 3′ sire ko sahi jagah rakhta hai. Bubble DNA par aage barhta hai, mRNA bahar nikalta hai aur peeche DNA dobara lipat jata hai.
3. Termination: gene ke aakhir mein GC wala hissa aur us ke baad AT pairs. RNA mein GC hissa khud se jor kar GC hairpin (loop) banata hai jis ke baad chaar ya zyada U ki dum. Hairpin se polymerase rukta hai; kamzor U-A jor hybrid ko thaam nahi sakte, RNA alag ho jata hai aur transcription ruk jati hai.
Eukaryotes mein phir mRNA ko 5′ cap, poly-A tail milti hai aur splicing hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
23. Describe the mechanism of protein synthesis.
Protein banne (protein synthesis) ka tareeqa bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Translation mein mRNA ke paigham se amino acids jor kar polypeptide banta hai.
Amino acids ki activation: aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase (20 qismein) har amino acid ko us ke khaas tRNA se jor kar aminoacyl-tRNA (aa-tRNA) banata hai.
1. Initiation: pehla aa-tRNA (prokaryotes mein N-formyl methionine, eukaryotes mein methionine) initiation factor ki madad se ribosome ki chhoti subunit se jurta hai; doosra initiation factor mRNA ka 5′ sira jorta hai aur anticodon ko start codon AUG par rakhta hai; bari subunit upar aa jati hai. Ribosome mein P site (peptide bond), A site (aane wala aa-tRNA) aur E site (bahar nikalne ki jagah), 5′ se 3′ tarteeb E-P-A.
2. Elongation: (i) agla aa-tRNA elongation factor ke saath A site par; (ii) peptidyl transferase P wale tRNA ka amino acid (chain) utha kar A wale amino acid se peptide bond se jorta hai; (iii) ribosome 3′ ki taraf teen nucleotides sarakta hai (translocation); chain wala tRNA A se P par, khali tRNA E par ja kar nikal jata hai aur A par naya codon; (iv) yeh dohraya jata hai jab tak stop codon A par na aaye.
3. Termination: stop codon ka koi tRNA nahi; release factor use pehchan kar polypeptide azad karta hai; tRNA nikal jata hai aur ribosome ki subunits mRNA se alag ho jati hain.

blocks.prompt:
24. Describe the difference between protein synthesis in prokaryotes and eukaryotes.
Prokaryotes aur eukaryotes mein protein synthesis ka farq bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Bunyadi tareeqa dono mein ek hai, magar yeh nukaat mukhtalif hain.

rows: mRNA foran translate; koi post-transcriptional tabdeeli nahi
Pehle mRNA mein tabdeeli: introns nikalna, 5′ cap aur 3′ poly-A tail
Transcription aur translation dono cytoplasm mein
Transcription nucleus mein; translation cytoplasm aur RER par

blocks.prompt:
25. Describe the importance of the regulation of gene expression.
Gene expression ki regulation (control) ki ahmiyat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Tamam genes ek hi waqt mein ya har cell mein kaam nahi karte; regulator proteins ke zariye genes ko ON aur OFF karna aur un ka waqt control karna gene expression ki regulation hai.
Ahmiyat:
1. Cells mahol ki tabdeeli ka jawab dete hain aur protein sirf zaroorat par banate hain, energy aur maadda bachta hai.
2. Kai cell wale jandaron mein yeh cell differentiation (cells ka mukhtalif ban jana) aur morphogenesis (shakal banna) ki bunyad hai: sab cells ka genome ek, magar har qism ke cell mein mukhtalif genes express hote hain. Maslan liver cells alcohol dehydrogenase ke genes chalate hain, dimagh ke neurons inhein OFF rakhte hain.
3. Nashonuma ke mukhtalif waqton par mukhtalif genes express hote hain.
4. Alternative splicing se ek gene mukhtalif cells mein ek se zyada polypeptides de sakta hai.
Satahein: transcription, post-transcription (mRNA ki tabdeeli), translation aur post-translation (protein ki folding, pukhtagi).

blocks.prompt:
26. Describe the negative and positive control of gene expression.
Gene expression ke negative aur positive control ko bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Transcription ki satah par genes ke paas regulatory sequences hoti hain jin se khaas regulatory proteins jurte hain.
1. Negative (manfi) control: repressor proteins operators (promoter ke qareeb DNA ke tukre) se jurte hain. Jura hua repressor RNA polymerase ka rasta rokta hai, transcription ruk jati ya kam ho jati hai; gene OFF.
2. Positive (musbat) control: activator (inducer) proteins operators se jur kar RNA polymerase ko promoter se jurne mein madad dete hain, transcription shuru ya tez; gene ON.
Eukaryotes mein khaas cells ke regulatory proteins splicing bhi control karte hain, introns ya exons mukhtalif tareeqon se nikalte hain, is liye ek gene se mukhtalif mRNAs aur polypeptides bante hain.

rows: Repressor operator se jur kar RNA polymerase rokta hai
Activator RNA polymerase ko promoter se jorwata hai

blocks.prompt:
27. Explain the post-transcriptional modification of mRNA.
mRNA ki post-transcriptional (transcription ke baad ki) tabdeeliyan samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Prokaryotes mein mRNA cytoplasm mein foran translate hota hai. Eukaryotes mein naya (kacha) mRNA nucleus se cytoplasm jata hai, is liye is mein tabdeeliyan hoti hain:
1. 5′ cap: pehle nucleotide (A ya G) se methylated GTP 5′-5′ jor se lagta hai; yeh mRNA ko nucleases aur phosphatases se bachata hai.
2. 3′ poly-A tail: 3′ sire par taqreeban 250 A nucleotides; transcript ko nucleases se tootne se bachati hai.
3. Splicing: introns (ghair coding hisse) nikal kar exons jor diye jate hain; mature mRNA mein sirf coding hisse. Introns katne ki wajah se cytoplasm pohanchne wala mature mRNA asal transcript se chhota hota hai.
Mukhtalif cells mein alternative splicing se ek gene se mukhtalif polypeptides ban sakte hain.

blocks.prompt:
28. Write a note on point mutations and their sources.
Point mutations aur un ke zaraye (sources) par note likhein.
blocks.explanation:
Point mutations ek ya chand nucleotides badalti hain (sab se aam gene mutations).
Qismein:
1. Substitution: ek nucleotide ki jagah doosra (maslan A ki jagah G); sickle cell anaemia.
2. Insertion: ek ya zyada izafi nucleotides, aam tor par replication ki ghalti se.
3. Deletion: ek ya zyada nucleotides nikal jana; maslan cystic fibrosis mein teen nucleotides.
Asraat: silent (amino acid wohi), missense (ek amino acid badla), nonsense (waqt se pehle stop codon).
Zaraye:
1. Physical nuqsan: ionizing radiation (X rays, gamma rays) free radicals bana kar phosphodiester bonds torti hai; UV saath wale pyrimidines (C, T) mein double covalent bond bana kar replication rokti hai.
2. Mutagen chemicals: kuch nucleotides jaise ho kar DNA mein shamil ho jate hain; kuch adenine ya cytosine se amino group hata dete ya hydrocarbon group jor dete hain, jis se ghalat jora banta hai (maslan mustard gas).
3. Khud ba khud (spontaneous): nucleotides doosri shakal mein shift ho kar ghalat jora banate hain; ghalat line mein aaye homologous chromosomes loop banate hain jo kat jata hai aur saikron nucleotides nikal jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
29. Describe the symptoms, causes and treatments Down syndrome and Klinefelter syndrome.
Down syndrome aur Klinefelter syndrome ki alamaat, wajah aur ilaj bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Down syndrome
Wajah: autosome jora 21 ki non-disjunction, aam tor par anday (egg) ke banne mein; 24 chromosomes wala egg aam sperm se mil kar trisomy 21 (2n+1 = 47) deta hai, larka ya larki. Taqreeban 750 mein se 1 bacha; maa ki umar ke saath khatra barhta hai.
Alamaat: zehni kamzori, ruki hui nashonuma, kamar aur gardan par izafi jild, chapta chehra, chhota sar, chhoti gardan aur baazu tangein, upar ko tirchhi aankhein, chhote kaan, kamzor patthe, bahar nikli zabaan, dil ke naqais; mard aksar baanjh, auratein kam fertile.
Ilaj (dekh bhaal): aam masail ki screening, zaroorat par ilaj, achha gharelu mahol, khaas taleem aur dekh bhaal.
Klinefelter syndrome
Wajah: sex chromosomes ki non-disjunction; XX egg aur Y sperm, ya XY sperm aur X egg se 44+XXY = 47 (Harry Klinefelter, 1942).
Alamaat: baanjh mard jis mein zanana khususiyaat (jism par kam baal, chhati ka barhna), chhote testes, lambi tangein, chhota dhar, kandhe kulhon ke barabar, kam bhari awaz.
Ilaj: balooghat par testosterone, chhati ki izafi baafat ka operation, zabaan, school aur samaji masail ke liye behavioural therapy.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Long sawal 29 aur 30 mein "of" reh gaya hai: "treatments Down syndrome" aur "treatments Turner syndrome". Durust: "treatments of Down syndrome" aur "treatments of Turner syndrome" (sawal 31 mein "of" chhapa hai).

blocks.prompt:
30. Describe the symptoms, causes and treatments Turner syndrome.
Turner syndrome ki alamaat, wajah aur ilaj bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Wajah: sex chromosomes ki non-disjunction se aisa egg (ya sperm) banta hai jis mein koi sex chromosome nahi (O). O egg aur X sperm (ya O sperm aur X egg) se zygote 44+XO = 45 (2n-1) banta hai, yani sex chromosomes ki monosomy; yeh baanjh larki banti hai (Henry Turner, 1938). (OY zygote zinda nahi rehta, kyun ke X chromosome ke genes zaroori hain.) Taqreeban 5000 larkiyon mein se 1.
Alamaat: chhota qad, jaali dar (webbed) gardan, kachay jinsi aaza aur baanjhpan, kam zehni salahiyat, chhoti thori aur jabra; jigar aur gurde ke masail, motapa, diabetes aur hypertension.
Ilaj: bachpan mein jaldi growth hormone dene se poora qad; estrogen replacement therapy se secondary jinsi khususiyaat.

blocks.prompt:
31. Describe the symptoms, causes and treatments of Sickle cell anaemia and phenylketonuria.
Sickle cell anaemia aur phenylketonuria ki alamaat, wajah aur ilaj bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Sickle cell anaemia
Wajah: haemoglobin ke β-globin gene (chromosome 11) ka recessive allele jis mein substitution point mutation hai: DNA mein T ki jagah A, is liye CTC (glutamic acid) CAC (valine) ban jata hai. Do mutant alleles wala bacha ghalat β chains banata hai; haemoglobin kam oxygen uthata hai aur RBCs daranti (sickle) jaise ho jate hain.
Alamaat: dard, thakan, saans phoolna, yarqan (jaundice), infections ka zyada khatra.
Ilaj: dard ki dawa (NSAIDs, opioids), sehatmand RBCs ke liye khoon lagana (transfusion), bone marrow transplant (lambe arse ka ilaj), mustaqil nigrani, vaccines aur antibiotics.
Phenylketonuria (PKU)
Wajah: chromosome 12 par normal gene jigar ka enzyme phenylalanine hydroxylase (PAH) banata hai jo phenylalanine ko tyrosine banata hai. Point mutation (substitution ya deletion) se recessive allele banta hai; do recessive alleles hon to PAH theek nahi banta aur phenylalanine zehrili had tak jama ho jata hai.
Alamaat: zehni kamzori, daure (seizures), rawaiye ke masail, chhota sar (microcephaly), saans, jild aur peshab mein baasi boo; dimagh ko nuqsan.
Ilaj: kam phenylalanine wali ghiza (gosht, doodh ki cheezein, anday, kuch anaaj se parhez), khoon mein phenylalanine ki baqaida jaanch, synthetic PAH wali dawaein, vitamins aur minerals.

blocks.prompt:
7. DNA is tightly wrapped around histone proteins. How can replication enzymes read the code if it is buried inside a coil?
DNA histone proteins ke gird kas kar lipta hota hai. Agar code kundli ke andar chhupa ho to replication enzymes use kaise parhte hain?
blocks.explanation: Jab DNA chromosome ki shakal mein sima hota hai tab replication nahi hoti. Replication interphase ke S-phase mein hoti hai jab chromatin khul kar bareek jaal ki shakal mein hota hai. Replication origins par nucleosomes ki packing dheeli ki jati hai (chapter se aage: chromatin-remodelling proteins aur histones ki tabdeeliyan nucleosomes ko dheela ya sarka deti hain), is tarah DNA tak pohanch mil jati hai. Phir helicase helix kholta hai, gyrase supercoils khatam karta hai aur single-strand binding proteins strands khule rakhte hain, aur polymerase bases parh leta hai. Fork ke peeche DNA purane aur naye histones ke saath dobara pack ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Our genetic code uses three-letter "words" to create 20 amino acids. Could a complex human exist if the code used only two-letter words?
Hamara genetic code 20 amino acids ke liye teen harfi "lafz" istemal karta hai. Agar code sirf do harfi lafzon ka hota to kya pecheeda insaan wujood rakh sakta?
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Chaar nucleotides se do harfi codons sirf 4 x 4 = 16 jore dete hain, jo 20 amino acids se kam hain, aur start aur stop ishare ke liye kuch na bachta. Ziyada se ziyada 16 qism ke amino acids ka code hota, is liye insaan ke bohat se proteins (enzymes, haemoglobin, antibodies) sahi tarteeb se na bante aur pecheeda insaan wujood na rakh sakta. Teen harfi code 4 x 4 x 4 = 64 codons deta hai, 20 amino acids aur start, stop ke liye kafi se zyada; izafi codons se degeneracy milti hai jo kuch mutations se bachati hai.

blocks.prompt:
9. DNA Polymerase III is a highly efficient proof-reader that fixes its own mistakes. What happens to a cell if the gene for the "proof-reader" enzyme itself gets a mutation?
DNA polymerase III bohat achha proof-reader hai jo apni ghaltiyan khud theek karta hai. Agar isi "proof-reader" enzyme ke gene mein mutation ho jaye to cell ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Mutation wale gene se bana enzyme ghaltiyan kam ya bilkul theek nahi karega. Replication mein bane ghalat jore theek na honge aur har replication mein ghaltiyon ki sharah barh jayegi. DNA ki stability (pukhtagi) khatam: har division ke saath tamam genes mein mutations jama hongi, un genes mein bhi jo nashonuma aur division control karte hain, aur ghaltiyan mazeed barhengi (chapter se aage: aise cells 'mutator' cells kehlate hain). Nateeja: kharab ya bekaar proteins, cell ki maut, ya be-qaboo division jo cancer bane. Germ cells mein ho to naqais aulad mein jate hain.

blocks.prompt:
10. Why the length of transcribed mRNA molecule (in eukaryotes) shortens as it enters the cytoplasm for translation?
Eukaryotes mein transcribe hone wala mRNA cytoplasm mein translation ke liye jate waqt chhota kyun ho jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Splicing ki wajah se. Eukaryotic genes mein exons ke darmiyan introns (ghair coding hisse) hote hain aur poora gene kachay mRNA mein transcribe hota hai. Nucleus se nikalne se pehle introns kaat diye jate hain aur exons jor diye jate hain, is liye cytoplasm pohanchne wala mature mRNA sirf coding hisson par mushtamil aur asal transcript se chhota hota hai (halan ke 5′ cap aur poly-A tail lagti hai). Prokaryotic genes mein introns nahi, is liye un ka mRNA chhota nahi hota.

blocks.prompt:
11. How many types of tRNA molecules are necessary for a living cell, if the genetic code is a triplet code?
Agar genetic code triplet hai to zinda cell ke liye kitni qisam ke tRNA molecules zaroori hain?
blocks.explanation: Triplet code mein 64 codons hain; 3 stop codons ka koi anticodon nahi, baqi 61 sense codons. Agar har sense codon ke liye alag complementary anticodon wala tRNA ho to cell ko 61 qisam ke tRNA chahiye. Kam az kam 20 qismein to zaroor chahiye, har amino acid ke liye ek, kyun ke har amino acid ka apna aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase aur tRNA hai. (Chapter se aage: 'wobble' ki wajah se codon ka teesra base dheela jora bana sakta hai, is liye ek tRNA ek se zyada codons parh leta hai; cells 61 se kam magar 20 se zyada qismon se kaam chala lete hain.)

blocks.prompt:
12. After isotopic labelling of the starting DNA with15N, Meselson and Stahl continue their experiment to at least two rounds of replication instead of stopping the experiment after only one round of replication. Justify their decision to continue to at least two replications.
Shuru ke DNA ko 15N se label karne ke baad Meselson aur Stahl ne ek round par rukne ke bajaye kam az kam do rounds tak tajurba jari rakha. Is faisle ka jawaz dein.
blocks.explanation:
Ek replication ke baad unhein ek darmiyani (hybrid) band mila. Is se conservative model radd hua (woh ek bhari aur ek halka band deta), magar yeh semi-conservative aur dispersive dono se mel khata tha, kyun ke dono mein har daughter DNA aadha 15N aur aadha 14N hota.
Doosri replication in dono mein farq karti hai:
- Semi-conservative: har hybrid se ek hybrid aur ek bilkul 14N DNA, yani do bands, darmiyani aur halka.
- Dispersive: har DNA mein taqreeban ek chauthai 15N, yani darmiyani aur halke ke beech ek hi band, alag halka band kabhi nahi.
Unhein do bands (darmiyani aur halka) mile, is liye sirf semi-conservative model sahi hai. Faisla karne ke liye kam az kam do rounds zaroori the.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "with15N" baghair space ke chhapa hai; durust "with 15N" (bhari nitrogen, nitrogen-15).

items: Kitab ki ghaltiyan: MCQ 31 (d) mein faltu "?"; MCQ 32 (c) "NA" yani "DNA"; short Q24 "Tuners" yani "Turner"; long Q29, Q30 mein "of" reh gaya; inquisitive Q12 "with15N" mein space nahi.
Short (8 sawal, Q24 ke 17 jore alag alag), long (17) aur inquisitive (6) sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath hain.
